name: Tame Sloth 39
author: Praashoo7
description: Rounded gray text input that lights up when focused.
howItWorks:
On focus, background-color changes from #ccc to #ffffff, transform becomes scale(1.05), box-shadow becomes 13px 13px 100px #969696,
             -13px -13px 100px #ffffff.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Tame Sloth 39</title>
<style>
/* Tame Sloth 39 by Praashoo7 — https://uiverse.io/Praashoo7/tame-sloth-39 */
.input {
  border: none;
  outline: none;
  border-radius: 15px;
  padding: 1em;
  background-color: #ccc;
  box-shadow: inset 2px 5px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
  transition: 300ms ease-in-out;
}

.input:focus {
  background-color: white;
  transform: scale(1.05);
  box-shadow: 13px 13px 100px #969696,
             -13px -13px 100px #ffffff;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<input type="text" autocomplete="off" name="text" class="input" placeholder="Username">

</body>
</html>
